title: Why a therapist matters — Priya, 36 (Story Arc)
caption:
Crying in the car but "fine" at work? Ask for CBT by name — about 75% of people who enter psychotherapy get some benefit (APA).
First session is mostly questions + a GAD-7 score.
Send this to her. Would you go — yes or not yet?
www.aiforheratx.org
#therapy #womensmentalhealth #cbt #anxietysupport #burnoutrecovery #momlife

scenes.text: Fine at work. *Crying* in the car.

scenes.text: Priya is 36, manages nine people, and wakes with a knot in her chest.
phrases: She manages a team of nine.
By 5:40 AM her chest is already tight.
She called it "just stress" for two years.

scenes.text: Her first session was mostly questions — and a *GAD-7* score to track anxiety weekly.
phrases: Her therapist asked questions and listened.
Then she scored a *GAD-7* — 7 quick anxiety questions.
That number becomes the progress they measure together.
scenes.attribution: — GAD-7, Spitzer et al., Arch Intern Med 2006

scenes.text: Tonight: message *three* CBT therapists. Tomorrow: a 20-minute walk (150 min/week, WHO).
phrases: Open a therapist directory and filter for *CBT* + your insurance.
Message three tonight — first replies come fastest.
Eat like the SMILES trial: veg, fish, olive oil (BMC Medicine 2017).
